author: Zintenka
body:
Well, its been a very long time since i last made a map for Avicus.

Heh, this changes now...

I'm back with a map that you will definitely have fun on! Four iconic kits with everything that you need! 

[DTM] Mercesion




Attacker

The main class with the purpose for full frontal assault on the enemy base, with an extra row of hearts and slowness 1!

Rusher

The ideal class for farming those monuments, very weak attacks but with haste 1 and speed 1!

Cannoneer

For those of you special and talented Avicadians out there who know who to properly use TNT's vast arsenal with great proficiency like myself, this is the class for you! Comes with night vision.

Archer

The trick shot class with a power II bow and night vision! Support your team by providing suppressive fire for your team!

Mind the pics, all kits have arrows!


Features

  • 25v25
  • kit-based
  • Each kill gives you 8 xp bottles and 4 pieces of bread!
  • Every block on the map has been added to the remove blocks syntax to drastically reduce lag.
  • Thunder death sounds! (If i knew all of 'em then I'd choose something else. Provide a link to all of 'em for me please?)

Special thanks to Alexanderjoe AKA ScriptingLyfe for the build server and voxel sniper!


Changelog v1.0

Attacker's effects have been changed to absorption 2 and slowness 2 with strength 1.

YAML

Download

Imgur

I bid thee adieu!

Its all good, except one thing.

Attacker is too overpowered.

Literally everyone will select Attacker, but not for the purpose of rushing - they will just killfarm and mess about with it, this is not good.

Either get rid of Attacker, or make it able to be earnt via a 10 kill streak without dying (like Points Shop).

Otherwise, it will be annoying having everyone with 20 hearts.

Apart from that, good map.
